title: At the Train Station
description: Four short recordings at a train station: buying a ticket, an announcement, a phone call and asking for help.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Buying a ticket
parts.intro: You will hear a man, Tom, buying a ticket at the station.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, please. I'd like a ticket to Oxford.

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Single or return?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Return, please. I'm coming back tonight. How much is it?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: A single ticket is twelve pounds, so a return is eighteen pounds.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. And what time is the next train?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: There's one at ten fifteen. It leaves from platform four.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Thank you. Is it a fast train?

script.speaker: Clerk
script.text: Yes, it takes one hour. You will be in Oxford at a quarter past eleven.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Perfect. Here is the money. Have a nice day!

parts.title: Part 2 · A station announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement at a train station.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Attention, please. The train to Manchester is late today. It will leave at five thirty, not five o'clock.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Please wait on platform two. Do not wait on platform one.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: The train to Bristol is now ready. It leaves in five minutes from platform six.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: A small black bag is on the bench near the cafe. Please take your bags with you.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Finally, the shop near the main door is open until nine o'clock tonight. Thank you.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Anna talking to her father on the phone from the station.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Hello, Dad. I'm at the station now. The train was twenty minutes late.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh dear. Are you hungry? Do you want me to cook dinner?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, please. I'd like chicken and rice. But first, can you pick me up?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Of course. I'm at home. I'll be there in ten minutes in the car.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Thanks. I'm in front of the station, next to the flower shop.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Is your bag heavy?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, very heavy! I have lots of books in it.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: OK. I'll wait for you at the door. See you soon, Anna.

parts.title: Part 4 · Asking for help
parts.intro: You will hear a girl, Mai, asking a man for help at the station.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Excuse me. I'm lost. I want to go to the airport.

script.speaker: Guard
script.text: No problem. You need the blue train. Go down these stairs.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Is the toilet near here? I need to go before the train.

script.speaker: Guard
script.text: Yes, it's behind the ticket office, on the left.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thank you. And do I need a ticket for the blue train?

script.speaker: Guard
script.text: Yes. You can buy one from the machine. It costs four pounds.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh, I only have a ten pound note. Is that OK?

script.speaker: Guard
script.text: Yes, the machine gives change. The train comes every fifteen minutes. Have a good trip!
